expectation: Membrane ring on myeloid cells (monocytes, macrophages, myeloid DCs, MDSCs), sometimes rare NK or plasma cells. A moderate minority of cells, scattered in tumour stroma and around vessels; often dim in IMC.
observed: A: signal fills whole tiles as haze and fibre texture, with intensity changing from image to image, not as discrete cells. B, C: faint grain with a few small bright specks. D: broad yellow wash between nuclei, no membrane rings.
why: The signal follows tissue texture and changes by image as diffuse haze; there is no distinct, membrane-ringed myeloid population at any scale.
notes: CD33 shows as haze and fibre-like texture spread over the tissue, with brightness that changes between images. The brightest cells (D) sit in a diffuse wash rather than showing myeloid membrane rings. B and C show only scattered grain.
